findings.claim: In admin-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was rewritten from i18next {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} placeholders to Java MessageFormat {0}..{2,choice,...} syntax. The Admin UI loads it with plain i18next and no ICU plugin, so the raw template text is shown instead of interpolated values.

verifier.reason: The patch changes js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138 from `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}` to `{0} … {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. The Admin UI uses plain i18next with default `{{ }}` interpolation and no ICU plugin (js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-37), ThemeResource.java:153 serves the values unconverted, and the key is rendered via t(key, params) in js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:79, so the raw template is displayed.

findings.claim: In account-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next {{N}} placeholders to MessageFormat {N}/choice syntax. account-ui uses default i18next interpolation without i18next-icu, so the string renders with raw placeholders.

verifier.reason: The patch changes js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188 from `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}}` to `{0} … {2,choice,…}`, while js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-47 builds a plain i18next instance (default `{{ }}` interpolation, no ICU plugin; none in package.json). The key is translated client-side with positional params in js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86 and the server serves the raw property value (ThemeResource.java:153), so the placeholders and choice block show up literally.

findings.claim: normalizeValue has special cases for specific keys (templateHelp, optimizeLookupHelp, linkExpirationFormatter, error-invalid-multivalued-size, email RTL styles) that bypass parts of sanitization.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:117-136 hard-codes exceptions that strip `CLAIM.<NAME>` (templateHelp), `<Extensions>` (optimizeLookupHelp), whole `{n,choice,...}` blocks (linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*, error-invalid-multivalued-size) and ` style="direction: rtl;"` in email files before the policy check at line 92, so that content is never sanitized. The exceptions are narrow, commented and deliberate, in a build-time verifier.

findings.claim: In verifySafeHtml, failures reading the file or its derived _en counterpart are rethrown as raw RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException, which is inconsistent with the rest of verify().

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:69-71 and :78-80 catch IOException for the file and the derived _en file and rethrow as RuntimeException, while verify() at :52-53 wraps IOException in MojoExecutionException; the RuntimeException is not caught by that handler and escapes unwrapped.

findings.claim: Anchors are matched by position against the English string, so a valid translation that reorders links is flagged. In addition, ANCHOR_PATTERN </?a[^>]*> also matches <abbr>, <area> and <audio>.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:153-158, `santizeAnchors` advances the translation and English matchers in lockstep and requires the i-th tags to be equal, so a translation that reorders two different links gets "Didn't find anchor tag". ANCHOR_PATTERN at line 145 is `</?a[^>]*>` with no boundary after `a`, so it also matches `<abbr>`, `<area>` and `<audio>`.

findings.claim: The method name 'santizeAnchors' is misspelled; it should be 'sanitizeAnchors'.

verifier.reason: The patch adds a private method spelled `santizeAnchors` at misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150 and calls it at line 88; the intended word is 'sanitize'. Both lines are added by the patch (change.patch:130, 192), and the name is used consistently so it compiles and behaves correctly.

findings.claim: The new dependencies, including owasp-java-html-sanitizer 20240325.1, have hard-coded versions in the module pom.xml. This duplicates the root pom.xml owasp.html.sanitizer.version property instead of being managed centrally, which allows version drift.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:78 hard-codes owasp-java-html-sanitizer 20240325.1 (and commons-text 1.13.0 at :83), duplicating the root property at pom.xml:119, so the two can drift. However, the module declares no <parent> (misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:23-25), so it cannot inherit the root property as written, and every existing dependency there is already hard-coded the same way (e.g. :61, :66, :72).

findings.claim: The common prefix/suffix trimming that builds the 'Illegal HTML' message does not cap start+end at the shorter string length. Overlapping indices make substring throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and abort the Mojo.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:102-109 bounds `start` and `end` only by each string's length, never by `length - start`, so line 111 can call `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` with begin > end. For example, value `x` against sanitized `x` gives start=8, end=4 and `substring(8, 4)` (assuming the sanitizer drops the stray closing tag; not executed). `verify()` (lines 46-56) catches only IOException, so the exception escapes through ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51.

findings.claim: Anchor sanitization consumes English matcher groups without validating counts, so a translation with more anchor tags than the English text can produce incorrect validation results.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:154 guards `englishMatcher.group()` behind `englishMatcher.find() &&`, so when the translation has more anchors than the English text the short-circuit falls to the else branch at line 157, which records "Didn't find anchor tag ..." and breaks. That is the correct validation outcome, and no group is consumed without a successful find.

findings.claim: The 'Didn't find anchor tag … in original string' error message omits the message key and file, unlike the 'Illegal HTML' message.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:157 emits "Didn't find anchor tag … in original string" without the key or file (the `key` parameter of santizeAnchors is unused), whereas line 111 emits "Illegal HTML in key <key> for file <file>".

findings.claim: All tests are positive detections, and no test asserts that a valid bundle yields zero messages. The duplicate-keys assertion was loosened from contains to hasItem.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/test/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessagePropertiesTest.java:30-52 holds only four tests, each asserting `hasItem(containsString(...))` on an error message; none asserts an empty result for a valid bundle, and no valid-bundle fixture is exercised. Line 33 changes the duplicate-keys assertion from `Matchers.contains` to `Matchers.hasItem` (change.patch:228-230).

findings.claim: The theme verifier anchor check does not fail when a translation drops an anchor present in the source, so translations can lose links and still pass.

verifier.reason: `santizeAnchors` at misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162 loops only over anchors found in the translation (`while (matcher.find())`) and never checks for English anchors left unmatched. A translation with fewer or no anchors adds no message, and the sanitizer comparison at lines 91-99 also passes since the value simply has no anchor tags.

findings.claim: For allowlisted keys, the whole {N,choice,...} block is replaced with '...' before sanitizing, so HTML inside a translator-supplied choice branch passes the check.

verifier.reason: `normalizeValue` at misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:124-126 replaces the whole `\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}` block with "..." for `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*` and `error-invalid-multivalued-size`, and it is applied to the translated value at line 84 before `policy.sanitize(value)` at line 92. Any markup without a `}` inside a choice branch (e.g. `1#`) is therefore removed before the comparison and never reported.

findings.claim: The owasp-java-html-sanitizer dependency version 20240325.1 is outdated compared with 20260313.1.

findings.claim: Email bundle detection uses file.getAbsolutePath().contains('email'), and English path derivation uses replaceAll over the absolute path. A checkout directory containing 'email' or 'resources-community' therefore changes behaviour for every file.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:74 derives the English file with file.getAbsolutePath().replaceAll("resources-community", "resources"), and line 132 gates the RTL-style stripping on file.getAbsolutePath().contains("email"). Both match against the whole absolute path, so a parent/checkout directory containing either string either points every file at a wrong English path (RuntimeException) or applies the email-only leniency to every bundle.

verifier.reason:

findings.claim: getEnglishValue uses MissingResourceException for control flow instead of checking bundleEnglish.containsKey(key).

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:164-172 calls bundleEnglish.getString(key) and catches MissingResourceException to fall back to "", rather than checking containsKey(key) first. Behaviour is correct; this is only a style point in a build-time verifier.

findings.claim: The new translator-facing HTML rules (HTML only where English has HTML; only br/p/strong/b; anchors identical to English) are not documented.

verifier.reason: The patch adds the enforcement in misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java (verifySafeHtml, POLICY_SOME_HTML with br/p/strong/b, santizeAnchors) but touches no documentation file; docs/translation.md:28-35 (the translator guidelines) says nothing about HTML or anchors, and no other .md/.adoc in the repo describes these rules.

findings.claim: santizeAnchors modifies value via replaceFirst while iterating matches, which can misbehave with repeated identical anchors.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:151-155 the Matcher is bound to the original immutable String, so reassigning `value` does not disturb iteration. Matches are visited left to right and every earlier identical anchor has already been removed, so `replaceFirst` always removes exactly the currently matched occurrence; repeated identical anchors are handled correctly.

The third part is wrong: `getEnglishValue` does use `key`, in `bundleEnglish.getString(key)` at line 167.
